infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Only if you turn on body signals: the front camera estimates attention, expression and pulse on your device while the feed is open, and the rear camera with the flash takes an optional 30-second fingertip calm reading. Frames are processed in memory, never stored or uploaded. This is an estimate, not a medical device. The camera is also used if you choose to take a photo for a post, or when you start a video call from a message.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Only if you choose to pair one: The Void connects to a Bluetooth heart-rate strap or watch to read heart rate on your device. Readings never leave your phone.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Only when you tap record in the composer, or during a voice or video call you start or answer from a message: The Void records a voice note to attach to your post, or carries your voice to the other person on the call. Nothing is recorded at any other time.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Only when you choose to attach one: pick photos or videos from your library to add to a post or reply. The Void does not browse your library.
